contract.model: Hard per-face F-column lengths; shear energy 0.5*mu*A*(normalized F1 dot F2)^2; interior hinge energy 0.5*G*rest_edge^2/(A1+A2)*theta^2; nodal selfweight from rest-area/3.
contract.reference_method: SLSQP constrained minimization followed by local KKT Newton refinement; two starting states; central FD energy gradient and constrained Hessian stability check.
contract.sampling: 8x2 and 16x4 free quads plus one held backing column. Root uses two fixed rows, not a half-cell virtual beam tangent.
contract.limitations: Discrete-model targets, not continuum exact cloth or native XPBD proof. Zero thickness, contact disabled, isotropic rigidity, prescribed shear modulus; no artist calibration claimed.

settings.boundary: All coordinates fixed at rows x=-dx and x=0. No symmetry/planarity/transverse rails; all remaining coordinates free.

expected.convergence_requirement: Also check hard yarn strain, pins, and force/stationarity or settled velocity; matching an angle alone is insufficient.
expected.scope: Stationary stable local minimum of this explicit discrete cloth model; not a certified global minimum or continuum calibration.
